
Action system builds on styra API.
Essentially pre-defined named scripts which can be written in rust or built interactively on the fly (within reason).

A lot of this can/should be replaced by linka when that is integrated, but this is an exploratory step on the way.

= Example actions/workflows =
- Commit, then if successful, seal conversation
- When finished with all queued prompts, branch off new session with some specific model, reviewing the work done.
